whittier-works.evidence: PG text opens with the Standard Library Edition publishers' advertisement (Riverside, revised by Whittier); vols I-IV are the poems (also PG 9567, 9574, 9580, 9586 one volume each)
whittier-works.case: The Riverside/Standard Library Edition is Whittier's own final arrangement of his poems; not held.
whittier-works.note: If only the verse is wanted, take PG 9567, 9574, 9580 and 9586 (vols I-IV) instead of the complete 9600.
